title: Thank you, Mr Pasteur!
kind: 对话 · 杰瑞米和妈妈聊牛奶的巴氏杀菌与巴斯德

timeline.text: While pouring a glass of milk, Jeremy notices something written on the package.
Hey, Mum! I just noticed a big word on the carton. PASTEURIZED. What does it mean?
Well, if something is pasteurized, it means that it has gone through a process of heating to a certain temperature.
Raw milk has dangerous bacteria and germs. We must heat milk to 72 degrees Celsius for 15 seconds to kill them.
Many years ago, people sometimes got sick when they drank milk. Some of them even died because of the bad bacteria.
Wow! Who discovered this heating process? A dairy farmer or a scientist?
It was Louis Pasteur, a French microbiologist. He discovered the process around 1864.
Mr Pasteur was one of the greatest scientists. His work saved millions of lives around the world. He was famous for his work on germs.
Well, here’s a toast to you, Mr Pasteur. Thank you for making the world much safer.
